name: Arcadia
source:
A legendary knight whose name is known throughout Talia. The people have given her numerous titles and accolades – the Scourge of the Battlefield, Champion of Kadath, the Protector of Amaranth Village – but she prefers to go by ‘Arcadia’.

She was a child warrior in her youth, who took up the sword to defend her country when she was only fourteen. Now more than a decade has passed, and Arcadia has grown tired of fighting. With her faith in her own country shaken, Arcadia has retired from the life of a warrior...

But things aren’t always that simple.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/729530/]Steam's Page[/url]]
